title: A billable entry in QB Unexported keeps its type
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online, with Inventory Asset and Cost of Parts mapped on its ShopView Accounts page, and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Make sure QuickBooks Online's closing date is the last day of last month.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Complete, billable, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Set the Invoice Date to a day of last month.
  4. Click Create invoice on the Finance tab.
  5. Open QB Unexported in ShopView.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Create invoice with its Invoice Date.

Step 3:

  • The date shows.

Step 4:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 5:

  • Work order 1's entry shows the type "Work Order Create".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11764 (Story 7, QuickBooks Online sync)

  • S7-N3: “If the posting date falls in a closed period, QuickBooks rejects the entry and it lands in QB Unexported under Journal Entries with the QuickBooks error text, the work order number and the classification (type "Internal Work Order Close", "Internal Work Order Reopen" or "No Charge line"), with Export and Mark as Exported as for other rows.”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan line 2718 (TP-307): “a billable work order's entry keeps "Work Order Create"”
